item.title: How to Use (Uni:Note)
item.description:
Introduction

Use these real screens to follow the main Uni:Note operations. You can keep writing with Apple Pencil, or turn on Draw with Finger to write with one finger.

Requires an iPad with iPadOS 17.0 or later. Recording transcription requires a supported environment with iPadOS 26 or later.

Search this guide

Enter a feature or action to jump directly to the relevant instructions.

item.title: How to use (Smokeless)
item.description:
Introduction

Use the green button to record an avoided cigarette and the red button to record a smoked cigarette. These screens show where to log, review and change settings.

Requires an iPhone with iOS 14 or later.

Basic use

Check the first tutorial and pack settings

After the first tutorial, enter Cigarettes per pack and Price per pack. These values are used for money conversions. You can change them later in Settings → General → Brands.

item.title: How to Use (Uni:Note Pocket)
item.description:
Introduction

Import a Uni:Note backup on iPhone to review notes, sticky markers and question sets. Pocket does not create, edit or sync notes. Tap screenshots to enlarge them.

Requires an iPhone with iOS 17.0 or later and a backup created in Uni:Note on iPad.

Basic use

Import a backup

  1. Export a backup zip from Uni:Note on iPad to a location accessible in the iPhone Files app.
  2. Close Pocket’s first-use notice and tap the import icon at the bottom right of Home.
  3. Choose the zip and wait for validation and import.

Choose the zip without unpacking it. The original backup is not modified. A failed import keeps the previously imported data.
